entries.title: Working in Tasks lists only work still going
entries.body: The Working group in the Tasks panel no longer lists finished tasks, such as a review or a plan that is already done, under the task they belong to. Those tasks now show under Done · 7d, and Working keeps a task beside its parent and its other open parts.

picture.alt: The Tasks panel with Working listing two working tasks, their parent and a held part, and five finished reviews and parts under Done · 7d
